steps.description:
One record per clinic visit, with a line item for every service or drug that was charged.

Where you go next: the benefit balances are what COVA reports as remaining after this visit, not what was spent — they step down as cover is used.

This feeds Visits & Cost on the Clinic Analytics dashboard: the month grid, the spend-by-purpose split, and the check that every cost has a matching Clinic Checkin on its date.

Fill the fields marked required and press Save (Ctrl+S). The onboarding step ticks itself off as soon as the record exists.
